recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑明顯增厚、形狀不規則並互相吻合連結，骨量增加使髓腔縮小，髓腔內可見紡錘狀細胞與膠原呈流水狀排列的纖維化，符合骨硬化（osteosclerosis）。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae occupying a large proportion of the core
Trabeculae with irregular contours and bulbous projections, with reduced intertrabecular marrow space
Intertrabecular marrow fibrosis with streaming spindle cells and collagen deposition
Patchy residual hematopoiesis and scattered adipocytes
Dilated sinusoids/vascular spaces within fibrotic areas
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bone trabeculae with a corresponding reduction in marrow space. The intertrabecular areas show fibrosis with streaming spindle cells and collagen, patchy residual hematopoiesis and dilated vascular spaces. Findings are consistent with osteosclerosis with marrow fibrosis, as seen in advanced myeloproliferative neoplasms such as primary myelofibrosis; reticulin and trichrome stains, megakaryocyte assessment and correlation with driver mutation studies (JAK2, CALR, MPL) are recommended.

ddx.vs: New bone formation is accompanied by clusters of cohesive cytokeratin-positive tumor cells within the desmoplastic stroma.
Shows peritrabecular fibrosis with increased osteoclasts and dissecting resorption along trabeculae rather than diffuse myeloproliferative changes.
Trabeculae show a mosaic pattern of irregular cement lines with prominent osteoclasts and osteoblasts, with preserved hematopoietic marrow.
Sclerotic trabeculae are associated with lambda-restricted plasma cells and lymphoid aggregates rimmed by plasma cells.
